name: Grader retry
responsibility: Holds each answer to what the report reads, and asks once more in the same session for the runs an answer fell short on
description: Short means a declared feature left unanswered, a feature invented, or a capture offered and not observed. The retry is a call of the session like any other, so its usage counts, and it is never itself retried; a retry owed by an earlier pass is asked on the next one.
